AdmissionRequest.description:
A request for one admission decision. The evaluator is pure: it resolves
nothing, fetches nothing, and reads exactly what it is handed.

capabilities.description:
The party's held capability references, matched against the offering's
requirements.

channel.description:
The authenticated channel, when the deployment allocates supply
through channel subquotas.

duplicateKey.description:
The duplicate-active key, derived the same way the offering's policy
prescribes.

externalReferences.description:
Opaque record links Scheduling retains with the hold or booking. Their
order is not significant.

policyRevision.description: The policy revision the caller resolved the offering under.

prerequisites.description:
The party's held prerequisite references, matched against the
offering's requirements.

windowRevision.description: The window revision the caller resolved an arrival window under.

CreateAppointmentRequest.description:
The request behind `POST /v1/appointments`: confirm a held allocation, or
create an appointment directly.

admission.description: The direct-create admission request. Mutually exclusive with `hold`.

hold.description: The hold being confirmed. Mutually exclusive with `admission`.

ExternalReference.description:
An opaque link to a record owned by another product.

Scheduling stores and returns this tuple without resolving it. The
identifier names only the referenced record; callers must not put personal
data in any field.

GrantReference.description:
An approval reference, never an assertion or bearer credential. The shared
Casework source requires the signed authority's original deadline to match.

PartyCounts.description:
The party summary capacity is derived from. Recipients are the people the
service is delivered to; attendees are everyone present, recipients
included. A parent accompanying two children is three attendees and two
recipients, and consumes recipient units, never attendee counts.
